description: Collect TrustRadius product profiles, review archives, product discovery cards or side-by-side comparisons.

categoryUrls.description: (mode=discover) TrustRadius category URLs or slugs, such as https://www.trustradius.com/categories/crm or crm.
categoryUrls.title: Category URLs or slugs

companySizes.description: (mode=reviews) Reviewer company sizes: small, medium or large. Leave empty for all sizes.
companySizes.title: Company sizes

countries.description: (mode=reviews) Reviewer country codes in ISO3 form, for example USA, CAN or GBR.
countries.title: Reviewer countries

departments.description: (mode=reviews) Departments such as Marketing, Engineering or Information Technology.
departments.title: Reviewer departments

includeProductDetails.description: (mode=product) Also collect feature scorecards, pricing plans, product details, FAQs and alternatives.
includeProductDetails.title: Include product details

includeReviewDetails.description: (mode=reviews) Open each review to collect ROI, alternatives and the full Q&A. Adds one request per review.
includeReviewDetails.title: Include full review details

jobTypes.description: (mode=reviews) Job types such as Engineer, Manager, Director or Analyst.
jobTypes.title: Reviewer job types

lastUpdated.description: (mode=reviews) Only include reviews updated within this window.
lastUpdated.title: Review recency

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted products, reviews, discovery cards or comparisons.
maxItems.title: Max records

maxReviewsPerProduct.description: (mode=reviews) Reviews to collect per product. Use 0 for the entire archive.
maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Max reviews per product

minYearsExperience.description: (mode=reviews) Minimum reviewer experience in years. Use 0 for no minimum.
minYearsExperience.title: Minimum years of experience

mode.description: What to collect: product profiles, individual reviews, product discovery cards or a side-by-side comparison.
mode.title: Mode

productUrls.description: TrustRadius product URLs, review URLs or bare slugs. Used by product and reviews modes; compare mode accepts a /compare-products/a-vs-b URL or two products.
productUrls.title: Product URLs or slugs

publishedAfter.description: (mode=reviews) Keep reviews published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty for no cutoff.
publishedAfter.title: Published after

reviewSort.description: (mode=reviews) Order in which reviews are collected.
reviewSort.title: Review order

reviewerRoles.description: (mode=reviews) Roles reviewers played: user, manager, support, decisionMaker, consultant or implementer.
reviewerRoles.title: Reviewer roles

searchQueries.description: (mode=discover) Keywords to search in the TrustRadius software directory.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

starRatings.description: (mode=reviews) Only reviews with these ratings (1-5), for example ["1","2"]. Leave empty for all ratings.
starRatings.title: Star ratings

title: TrustRadius Scraper Input
